notes.md: - **International Olympiad in Artificial Intelligence (IOAI):** first held in **Burgas, Bulgaria (August 2024)**, on Bulgaria's initiative; the second was held in **Beijing, China (August 2025)**.

new.s: Which of the following is an example of full duplex transmission?
new.x: In full duplex, data flows both ways at the same time, as in a telephone call.
new.angle: U0703 notes gap: full duplex -> telephone

new.s: Radio and television broadcasting are examples of which transmission mode?
new.x: Simplex is one-way transmission, as in radio and TV broadcasts.
new.angle: U0703 notes gap: simplex -> broadcast

new.s: How many layers are there in the OSI model?
new.x: The OSI model has seven layers, from Application at the top to Physical at the bottom.
new.angle: U0703 notes gap: OSI seven layers

new.s: Which is the top layer of the OSI model?
new.x: The Application layer (HTTP, FTP, SMTP, DNS) is the top layer; the Physical layer is the bottom.
new.angle: U0703 notes gap: OSI top layer

new.s: Which company released Java Server Pages (JSP) in 1999?

new.s: Which technology links devices with each other without a LAN?
